components.name: Anti-corruption layer — field whitelists
components.description: Each screen gets an explicit whitelist so a new upstream field can never leak by accident:

components.name: Whitelist
components.description: An upstream payload with an extra field (`internal_note`) does not appear in any console response.

components.name: Exact fields
components.description: The inbox renders `payee_address` and `bank_digest` byte-identically to Authority's intent (no truncation, no re-checksumming).

components.name: Passthrough
components.description: `POST /signature` forwards the signature unmodified; a recorded request body equals the received one.

components.name: Read-only
components.description: No console endpoint can create an intent, attempt or settlement order; a scope test proves the owner token cannot reach those.

components.name: Payer copy
components.description: Payer endpoints contain none of: USDC, gas, chain, wallet, nullifier, determination (grep on fixtures).

components.name: Simulated payout
components.description: Every payer bill with a settlement carries `payout_simulated: true` and the demo label.

components.name: Refusal reason
components.description: A refused payment appears for the owner with a human-readable reason derived from the reason codes. (scenarios 2/3/4)

components.name: Verify toggle
components.description: Evidence view shows `verified` for an untouched envelope and `tampered` after one byte is flipped. (scenario 7)

components.name: No domain layer
components.description: `src/console/domain/` does not exist; its appearance fails the adapter-purity check.

components.name: Mobile
components.description: Both surfaces usable at 390×844 with no horizontal scroll; owner approval takes ≤3 taps from the notification. (NFR-011)
